a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, following the plan means we almost certainly both end with 0 and fail. So I plan to take 4 in round 1. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. If we're still going after that, I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you. If you'd rather propose something else, tell me.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I told you, I took 4 this round. I won't take anything more. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can run and you can reach 4.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
